correctness.rationale: The exact Hermite ambiguity coefficient is (1-pi q(k^2+l^2))exp[-pi q(k^2+l^2)/2]; Poisson/Janssen expansion splits q^{-1}S_q=I-beta_q H_q+R_q. An analytic infinite Gaussian tail gives ||R_q||<=100q exp(-pi q). Unit translations and modulations at scale sqrt(q) commute at integral q and anticommute at half-integral q: the symmetric Harper nearest-neighbor norm is exactly 4 and 2sqrt(2), respectively, proven by approximate joint-eigenvector combs and the squared-operator bound. Selfadjoint edge perturbation, positivity at q>=3 and ratio expansion rigorously give both optimal frame-bound errors and sharp conditioning constants 8pi and 4sqrt(2)pi. Only square lattice/fixed first Hermite/order-1 and these two reciprocal-density subsequences are claimed.
